scope: SDevice-only production-SG input and factor audit for edges incident on the first free drain layer

factorization.source: reuse the exact M18 edge-level M17 three-factor game
factorization.closure: factor sum equals imported-state minus Vela-state production edge flux

decision_questions: Which incident edges create the node-991/992 contact-versus-internal flux imbalance?
Are the differences carried by endpoint phin imbalance, the SG state conductance, or mobility?
Do carrier density, Bernoulli weights, mobility drive, mobility, or geometry change materially on those edges?
Does the production stable SG decomposition reproduce every selected edge flux?
interpretation_limits: Both frozen states are evaluated by the unchanged Vela SG operator; private Sentaurus face quantities are not exposed.
The M17/M18 factors partition the Vela operator response and are not native Sentaurus residual terms.

Carrier densities are reported as production state diagnostics; in the Boltzmann variable-ni SG kernel they also enter mobility state dependence while the stable flux is expressed through psi, phin, and effective ni.
Deep-off relative ratios remain cancellation-sensitive and are not used as headline acceptance metrics.
